captions.detailed: A compact mini air fryer with a dark grey, rounded square shell body, a shallow pullout basket drawer, and a simple control interface. On top of the body sits a single fluted timer knob, while a small rectangular program button is located on the front face. The basket drawer, equipped with a projecting handle and a small light-colored release button, slides prismatically out from the lower front cavity of the main housing.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a compact mini air fryer with a rounded square body, a hollow cooking cavity, and a front-sliding basket drawer. Include a top rotating timer knob, a front push button, and a basket drawer with a handle and a small sliding release button, ensuring appropriate prismatic and continuous joints.
captions.factory: Construct the main body housing by extruding a rounded rectangle and shelling it to create a hollow cooking cavity. Model the top timer knob using a lofted or extruded cylinder with ribbed details, and position it on the top face. Construct the basket drawer using a matching rounded-rectangle extrusion that is shelled, attach a rectangular handle to its front face, and add a small push button on top of the handle. Define a prismatic joint for the drawer along the depth axis, a continuous rotary joint for the top knob, and a prismatic joint for the handle release button.
